meta.title: APEX // Compute Collection 2026
meta.description: The premiere of 2026's flagship server hardware: AMD EPYC 9996 “Venice”, AMD EPYC 9965, Micron 512GB DDR5 RDIMM and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell.

hero.subtitle: Four flagships setting the bar for next-generation data centers: processors, memory and graphics — shown like exhibits in a dark gallery.

teaser.title: 8 chiplets. 32 cores in each.
teaser.body: Next, the lid lifts and we look inside Venice. This scene arrives in the next stage.
